issues.reason: Names and casing mandates lemmatizing to the dictionary base form under 'Inflection only — never derivation', and the base form of 're-fires' is 're-fire', not 'fire'; stripping a prefix and re-encoding it as an operator is the same move the phrasal-verb rule forbids ('do not split off or drop the particle', 'do not swap in a single-word synonym'), so (Member (sk_fire $x) fire) records a verb the text does not use.

The Implication ranges over the OBJECT — for every damaged dome anywhere, this specific glassworks fires it at 0.9 — which asserts more than a habitual about one individual's practice states; the Quantifiers rule form is defined to range over a generic KIND SUBJECT, and 'emit the one the surface shows' (the cooper/coopers contrast) bars promoting a definite singular subject's habit into a universal over its objects.

gaps_confirmed: A derivational prefix on a verb ('re-fire'): the lemmatization rule covers inflection and cross-part-of-speech derivation but is silent on a prefixed verb, and no operator is licensed for 're-' — so the compliant one-symbol form loses the repetition presupposition entirely (the Again tag is defined for the particle 'again').

A habitual clause with a specific individual subject and a bare-plural object carrying a descriptive modifier ('damaged domes'): the bare-kind object filler takes no modifier, fusion is barred for damage modifiers, a witness would make the object specific, and the rule route is defined only for a kind subject — so no licensed form carries the restriction.
new_gaps: A specific individual's standing practice has no property-style carrier either: the kind-level reified forms ((can …), (obligated …), ConditionalProperty) all attach to a KIND, so even the fallback of stating the disposition as a property is unavailable for 'the glassworks', leaving the unmarked-event habitual with a bare-kind object as the only route — and that route cannot carry an object restriction.
defect_summary: For the verb, the compliant form keeps one surface symbol — (Member (sk_re_fire …) re_fire) — with no Again tag, since Again is reserved for the particle 'again'; for the clause, NO compliant form is licensed: an unmarked habitual event with Agent sk_glassworks_1 and the bare kind filler 'dome' as Patient is the only licensed shape, and it cannot carry 'damaged' (fusion is barred for damage modifiers, a witness would make the object specific, and object-ranging rules are not a licensed form), so Core patterns leaves only 'leave the whole claim out and record the gap'.
notes: The reviewer filed the 're-' problem both as an issue and as a gap; both stand — the gap is why the compliant form loses the repetition, not a reason to accept the split. (Inheritance glassworks works) is a correct solid-compound genus with the noun modifier suppressed, and 'damaged' as an adjectival Member atom is right.
